title: On spectrum of sample correlation matrices from large fold tensor vectors
summary: In this paper, we investigate the limiting spectral distribution of the sample correlation matrix, whose sample vectors are $k$-fold tensor products of $n$-dimensional vectors with i.i.d. entries. We focus on the limiting regime $n,k \to \infty$ with $k = o(n)$, and we show that the limiting spectral distribution is the Marčenko-Pastur law. As a consequence, we show that the limiting spectral distribution of the Whishart matrix from the $k$-fold tensor product of independent uniformly distributed unit vectors in $\mathbb C^n$ is the Marčenko-Pastur law.
